title: A US couple just gave their old engineering college a record $4 million
sources: Careers360 - BITS Pilani alumnus donates USD 4 million endowment fund scholarships
American Bazaar - Indian American couple gifts record $4M to BITS Pilani
caption:
A US couple just gave their old engineering college a record $4 million. The largest individual gift the school has ever received.

Chand P. Garg, a 1968 mechanical engineering graduate of BITS Pilani now based in the US and his wife Manju Garg pledged $4 million to the institute's endowment fund in early 2026. The gift is expected to fund scholarships for roughly 16 students a year, prioritizing merit, financial need and women students - pushing the endowment past $34 million toward a $100 million goal.

Most alumni write a check and move on. He wrote the biggest one his college has ever received.
